_help: Glow on worn gear and weapons (scripts/GearFx.cs). Colour = the item's element if it has one, else its rarity colour. Per rarity (Common..Legendary): edge = fresnel edge glow strength (armor uses armorScale of it), emit = body emission, pulse = how much the glow breathes, light = small light on weapons, sparks = particles per second on weapons. Elements: name word used in item names, colour, and the status a weapon of that element can inflict ('proc' chance per hit). elementChance = chance a weapon/armor of that rarity rolls an element.

upgrade._help: Smith upgrades (Item.Up): added per level to the edge glow and weapon emission; at pulseAt the glow breathes, at sparksAt weapons spark.
